notes.title: Trixie Release (Version 2.69)
notes.notes:
Trixie is here to help!

What's NEW in the Trixie Release:


 NEW Trixie Helper to walk you through the early levels (replaces the training level)
 Trixie also replaces the in-game help. She answers questions about the game based on your prompts
 All NEW Look! Every screen has been updated and improved with clearer animated text
 Brand NEW intro cutscenes and onboarding
 Levels and Trophies screens have been updated to clearly show unlockable items and level progression
 Multiplayer and Game Select screens have been updated with clearer animated text and descriptions
 NPC tweaks for a more enjoyable and smoother gameplay

notes.title: Festive Release (Version 2.45)
notes.notes:
This release includes:


 A Happy Holidays Billboard in opening titles
 Better animated goals and streaks
 Better looking Lie and True reveals

notes.title: Version 2.42 - Brand New Gameplay Look
notes.notes:
Bullcrap is looking so much bolder and cuter!

This release has:


 Cuter Cartoony Eyes on all of the players.
 Creatures such as sheep, goats, cows and pigs now have mouths, so they can emote much better.
 Thick shiny playing cards! The cards have a new look which makes them feel more a part of the action.
 Big Flashy Buttons! They replace the shiny donut rings as to entice you to play.
 Bigger Clearer Goals and Streaks. The goals and streaks are now shiny bars at the top of the play screen.
 The play is now zoomed in so you are closer to the action.

notes.title: Pirate Week Release (Version 2.30)
notes.notes:
Yarrrr! Me Hearties! Pirates have captured the farm!
The 17th - 22nd September is Pirate Week. 
(September 19th is Talk Like a Pirate Day!)

For this week only all NPCs:


 Are dressed as Pirates!
 Tell pirate JOKES! (When idle for 1 minute)
 Talk like Pirates! (occasionally)

In the Shop there's a new Eyepatch to wear (A steal at 5 Buckycoins!)
Plus the Pirate Hat has been discounted to just 5 Buckycoins too!

So climb aboard me filthy bilge rats and show us how treacherous a pirate ye can be!

notes.title: Robots & Teams Release (Version 2.26)
notes.notes:
Multiplayer gameplay has just gotten way more FUN!
You can now play games in TEAMS!
Plus, you can now add ROBOTS to the game to add extra players to the dynamic.
Team play games consist of 4 players with 2 teams . (Red & Blue)
Don't have 4 players? Just add robots!

notes.notes: This release includes a couple of extra tweaks to the Ultra graphics mode to make it even better!

The title screen now has more things you can interact with!
Calling "Bullcrap" and receiving rewards now highlights the cards by dimming the background
Rewards icons are now clearer

notes.title: Friends Release - Update 1
notes.notes: Removed the limit on the number of friends allowed.

notes.title: Friends Release
notes.notes:
Welcome to ALL NEW the Friends Release!
It is now easier to invite friends to multiplayer games. 
No game codes required!
All you need is to Find your friends via their Friend Code.
Add them once, then inviting them to a game is a few taps away.
This release also features our new logo and menu styles.

notes.title: Version 1.34 - Christmas Update
notes.notes:
All characters now have larger, more expressive Eyes
 New Multiplayer Lobby Screen with clearer descriptions of the available game types
 All New Twitch Emote
 New Jetson Pony
 Daily Challenges to give you access to previously un-played levels
 Daily Rewards! - You gain extra coins each day you play the game
 Christmas Theme - All characters wear Christmas hats for December
 Christmas Jokes - When idle, characters tell Christmas jokes (in December only) instead of Farm Jokes
